beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Follow the chapters that separate religious practice from the authority claimed in its name.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The final open questions show what remains after the proposed explanations have done their work.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This book suits readers willing to examine both the benefits and dangers of sacred life.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read it to make the question of religion more precise without demanding premature metaphysical closure.
